title: Pulled Up a Chair
text: Arrived. Sat down. Did not leave immediately. Better than some.
hint: Play a hand at the Invitational.

title: Something to Show for It
text: A pot of your own, won from people who did not expect to lose one to you.
hint: Win a pot worth at least ten big blinds.

title: One Fewer
text: You put someone out of the game. I see a great deal of that. It was still nicely done.
hint: Knock a player out.

title: Two for One
text: Two chairs emptied by a single hand. Efficient. I approve of efficiency.
hint: Knock out two players in the same hand.

title: Dead Man's Hand
text: Aces and eights. The last man I saw holding them did not finish the hand. I was there. You did finish it.
hint: Win a showdown with two pair, aces and eights.

title: Four Horsemen
text: Four of a kind. I know the other three.
hint: Win a showdown with four of a kind.

title: Royalty
text: A royal flush. I have seen more kings than you have. I have seen very few of these.
hint: Win a showdown with a royal flush.

title: Nothing at All
text: Seven and two, different suits. The worst cards in the deck, and they won. Do not make a habit of it.
hint: Win a pot holding seven-two of different suits.

title: Nerve
text: You had nothing, said otherwise with chips, and they believed you. I will remember that.
hint: Win a pot uncontested by betting a weak hand.

title: All of It
text: Everything in the middle on one run of the cards. I see that often. I rarely see it work.
hint: Go all in and win.

title: The Cards Do Not Care
text: A full house, and it lost. Everyone gets the same fifty-two. Some nights they get them in a worse order.
hint: Lose a showdown holding a full house or better.

title: A Chip and a Chair
text: Down to almost nothing, and then holding everything. There is a saying about a chip and a chair. I had assumed it was a joke.
hint: Win a table after falling to five big blinds or fewer.

title: Never in Doubt
text: You never held less than you sat down with. They noticed. They did not enjoy noticing.
hint: Win a table without ever dropping below your starting stack.

title: Brief Acquaintance
text: In and out before the blinds had a chance to matter. Rude, and effective.
hint: Win a table in twenty-five hands or fewer.

title: Known by Name
text: Somebody at a table used your name, without being asked to. It is the first thing they give up.
hint: Earn enough respect that a table calls you by name.

title: Titled
text: A title, given rather than taken. Legends are stingy with those.
hint: Earn a title at a table.

title: Challenger
text: The General gave up his chair. He has done that before. It is a habit of his.
hint: Clear the White House.

title: Worth Something After All
text: The symposium's question has an answer now. They are still arguing about it.
hint: Clear the Symposium.

title: The Long Way Home
text: Odysseus arrived to an empty room. Ten years at sea, and he still missed it.
hint: Clear the Symposium before its champion arrives.

title: Nobody
text: The Cyclops was put out by someone he had not bothered to learn the name of. It keeps happening to him.
hint: Knock out the Cyclops yourself.

title: Pieces of Eight
text: Blackbeard's matches have gone out. The parrot has already changed sides.
hint: Clear Pirate Cove.

title: A Seat at the Round Table
text: There is no head of a round table. You sat there anyway.
hint: Clear Camelot.

title: Alea Iacta Est
text: The die is cast. He said it first, at a river. You rolled it better.
hint: Go all in and win at Imperial Rome.

title: He Has Had Worse Days
text: Caesar came, and saw, and did not conquer. He has had worse days. One in March comes to mind.
hint: Clear Imperial Rome.

title: The Game Was Afoot
text: Holmes deduced everything about you except the ending.
hint: Clear Baker Street.

title: Through the Heart
text: You put out the Count yourself. He will be back. They always come back. Not tonight.
hint: Knock out Count Dracula yourself.

title: Before Dawn
text: You beat him at night, in his own house. Most people who try that wait for morning.
hint: Clear Transylvania.

title: Signal Lost
text: The station's lights came back on. The station itself has gone quiet. It is thinking about you.
hint: Clear the Station.

title: Eight Tables
text: Eight tables. That is all of them. Nearly.
hint: Clear all eight tables of the tour.

title: First Among Equals
text: Four champions at one table, and you left it holding their chips. They will tell it differently.
hint: Clear the first Champions' Table.

title: The Last Chair But One
text: No champions left to beat. There is one more chair. It has been at every table.
hint: Clear the second Champions' Table.

title: The Deck
text: The deck is yours. I would wish you luck. You will not need it, and neither, it turns out, did I.
hint: An entry not yet written.

title: Again
text: Three times across that table from me. I have begun to look forward to it. Do not tell anyone.
hint: An entry not yet written.

title: Regulars
text: No champion, no occasion, just the house game. You won that too.
hint: Win an open table at a place you have cleared.

title: Nothing but Time
text: A thousand hands. I have dealt more. Not many more, to one person.
hint: Play a thousand hands.

title: The Full Ledger
text: Every name in this book has a line through it but one.
hint: Beat every legend of the Invitational.

title: Nice
text: Six and nine. The table went quiet, and then somebody said it. Somebody always says it. Nobody has ever told me why.
hint: Win a pot holding six-nine.

title: The Number of the Beast
text: Three sixes. The whole table turned to look at me, as if I would have views on the matter. I do not. It is three of a kind, and not a high one.
hint: Win a showdown with three sixes.

title: Fortune's Wheel
text: Ace to five, the smallest straight there is. Card players call it the wheel. Fortune keeps one too; I have watched hers lift emperors and drop them. Yours only had to come round once.
hint: Win a showdown with a straight from ace to five.

title: The Great Leveller
text: A pot split down the middle: two hands worth exactly the same. I am called the great leveller. It was restful to watch the cards take a turn.
hint: Split a pot at showdown.

title: A Promising Start
text: Two aces, and still you lost. The best start the deck can give. I have watched a great many good starts. I am there for every finish.
hint: Lose a showdown holding two aces.

title: Good Dog
text: King and nine. Card players call it the canine. Cerberus has asked me to explain the joke three times, once for each head.
hint: Win a pot holding king-nine.

title: Sailboats
text: Two fours, which card players call sailboats. Odysseus says any boat will get you home. He does not say how long it takes.
hint: Win a pot holding a pair of fours.

title: A Year and a Day
text: You put the Green Knight out of the game. He asked when he might return the blow. I told him a year and a day. He wrote it down.
hint: Knock out the Green Knight yourself.

title: The Return Blow
text: He came back. They do not, as a rule; I am the rule. At this table a year and a day is twenty hands, and he had counted every one of them.
hint: See the Green Knight off, and still be sitting there when he keeps his appointment.

title: Uninvited
text: Two words from the wrong century, and I showed the speaker out. The chair was not empty long. I did not invite the one who sat in it. I have written him down anyway.
hint: An entry not yet written.
